title: Wack 100 Says The Game's Next Album Could Drop Under Virgin, Themselves, Or Under Conor McGregor's Label
htmlContent:
Wack 100 was on Clubhouse on Thursday afternoon and was asked if the game would retire or drop another project.

"Man, that n*** ain't gonna never retire. He likes rapping too much. Yeah, I'm going to place the album right now; I either got virgin, or we do it ourselves, or Conor McGregor, the MMA fighter. He wants me to keep one open-up a label and wants me to run the label over there," says Wack 100.

"So that might be the best situation because the budget gonna be crazy. So, I signed that paperwork by January or February, so if I do that, then that's probably where it's gonna be Game don't care where it drops at because we control our own marketing and all that s*** anyway as long as the money is there."

Speaking of McGregor, he has been calling out Artem Lobov on social media.

Not only did McGregor drop a dozen new disparaging nicknames for Lobov, he challenged his old friend and training partner to a brawl at the Concord Straight Blast Gym.

“This is callout to Artem ‘the fanny, furly-pad’ Lobov,” McGregor wrote in a since-deleted tweet. “I’m challenging you to a fight tonight, 10:30 p.m. at SBG Concord, and we’ll fight for the whole lot. We’ll fight for the whole lot. Going through and having lawyers message me about defamation and all this, suing and all. You’re a little blouse-mate. We’ll see you at SBG Concord tonight at 10:30 p.m. and we’ll fight you for the whole lot, yeah? Answer this F***ing callout, yeah, you little blouse.”

The callout caught the attention of Nate Diaz and he asked a question via Twitter.

"So is Artem gonna show up to the big fight or what ?"
